name: Necromancy Rituals — 1 Basic — Minestra di Morte

system.description: The Necromancer simmers a piece of a dead body with two Blood Traits' worth of vampiric vitae, rosemary, basil, and salt, then eats the resulting stew. On success, the caster learns whether the person whose body-piece was used became a spirito or spettro after death (or neither) — but only about that specific individual. If the flesh came from a still-living victim, the Necromancer learns only that the subject is not (yet) a ghost.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
